description_text:
Faucet single lever wall mixer 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 8030 vertices, 7860 quad faces (15720 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

A collection of over 50 ready to render, Junk Yard kit elements with original PBR rusty metal materials/maps; including the original Substance Painter material.
I created this product from a combination of original built elements and several of my favorite existing element from the Tech Heavy Pro Kit. All elements have been unwrapped with texture/materials created for each individual element. Each material has accurate wear and tearing, rust, scratches, grime and all the Substance goodness! This kit is perfect for adding random parts to sci-fi scenes or building crazy machines and robots!
In addition I created a second symmetry branch collection from the original models to create some new, unique and interesting sci-fi looking designs! I really think the product is worth it just for these elements alone! It's a lot of fun creating symmetry branches. Try this yourself; throw a Symmetry modifier onto an element and play around with the angle etc .. you can get some very unique designs. I have tutorial that goes deeper into this process called Rapid Symmetry Design if you're interested.

Original files created in 3ds Max 2016 / Vray 3.5 (back saved to 2015)
I've also includes files with the elements simulated into a pile!

description_text:
Stylized flying saucer toy 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 23490 vertices, 23446 quad faces (46892 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Extra Turrets is an EXPANSION KIT of 3D printable files that contains two new turrets that can be used with our LAV and Tank kits. They have been designed to print easily in FDM and resin and to work with 28-32mm scale figures. 
Components
The Extra Turrets kit has core components and variant pieces. Included are:

  - An AA/Anti-Aircraft Turret with multiple weapon options, including cannon, gatling weapons, and surface to air missiles.

  - An Autoloader Tank Turret with a variety of three crew weapons, and a variety of tank and other main guns.

  - A scanning radar dish that replaces the small top turret hatch.

Build instructions and photos are included. This is an EXPANSION KIT so the LAV or Tank kits will be required to build a complete vehicle.
Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home FDM 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.1 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - Assembly of printed parts is required.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print them immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3. All resin parts were test printed on a Creality LDR-02.

description_text:
A cute, fully rigged and textured sci fi self-driving car. The midsection is flexible and easily controlled with the armature. The wheels automatically rotate to stay locked with the ground as the body flexes and as the car moves. In the blend file the wheel rotation is controlled by a driver linked to the Y position, but you can edit this by selecting the wheel controller bone in the center and editing the driver on the Y rotation. you can even delete the driver and easily animate the rotation yourself using the controller bone.
Note: the headlight, scratched clear plastic wheel guard and interior light materials were made in blender for cycles and will most likely only work in the blend file.

X-WING MODEL KIT
This kit include 228 individual parts, takes about 3 hours of pleasure to assemble.Included, 170 assembly pictures in jpg format.
I know, you can have an X-WING stl in one piece, but i personnaly like to put the pieces together!
Take a trip to your childhood!
Final model is 16x 22 ,  weight approx 1400g
NO GLUE needed. All pieces designed to prees-fit, clip, or held in place with another piece.  You may want to use glue, but the model don’t need it.
The files are delivered in STL format. Your slicer may indicate some parts non-manifold, it does however print fine.
You will receive parts grouped in framed kit, to fit the bed of standard printers. Framed parts are best for bed adhésion, and also for spray painting if you like. Also included individuals files, if you need to print only one. RESIZE ALL INDIVIDUALS FILES AT 10% BEFORE PRINTING
DISCLAIMER ::  Good 3D printing is mostly a matter of setting of your printer, settings of your slicer and filament used. I offer no support for the actual printing process.

description_text:
Metal Gear REX Low Poly
Polys: 265Verts: 409
The nuclear weapons disposal facility on Shadow Moses Island was constructed to conceal the development of Metal Gear REX. Its rail gun was based on technology developed for the SDI, having been successfully miniaturized in a joint venture between ArmsTech and Livermore National Labs. Livermore also developed a new type of nuclear weapon for REX using NOVA and NIF laser nuclear fusion testing equipment and supercomputers.
One of the main goals of developing REX was to overcome a global trend in military downsizing at the time. A weapon such as REX would cause an immediate rift in the global power structure. REX was a self-mobile launch platform capable of using its massive rail gun to launch a nuclear warhead contained projectile package with a low radar cross-section, and without the need for a rocket propulsion system, the launch event was also undetectable by satellite thermal imaging unlike the massive heat signature characteristic of ICBM launches. It could give any country in the world a first-strike capability that other nations would find hard to counter. This also exploited a specific loophole that existed in anti-nuke treaties, since projectiles fired from a rail gun were not technically ICBMs, so the START treaties imposing limitations on ballistic missiles did not apply.
During REX's development, the Metal Gear engineers became concerned of what would happen if REX, after it was completed and doing solo ops in the field, was detected by the enemy and forced to engage in close range combat against conventional forces. They then decided that they could make REX's hull a weapon in itself. Although the program was completed, and had gotten fantastic results from supercomputer simulation, the military shelved the project before they could even install it (as the military viewed it as not being part of their regulations). However, REX's chief engineer Hal Emmerich secretly uploaded the data into REX anyway. Although the first actual prototype for REX was developed in 2005, it went through multiple prototype stages in VR while it was still in the design stage to correct various flaws before being developed. As REX was primarily tested via VR simulations, the Pentagon and ArmsTech needed to perform live testing to compare the simulation data with actual test results. Because of this, they started a field exercise at the remote military facility on Shadow Moses Island.

description_text:
Discovery was launched from the San Francisco Fleet Yards. Command was given to Captain Gabriel Lorca who, unbeknownst to Starfleet Command, was in fact a Terran from the mirror universe and sought to use the ship to return to his universe. (DSC episodes: Context Is for Kings, Vaulting Ambition)
After war broke out between the Federation and the Klingon Empire in May 2256, the Discovery and her sister ship, the USS Glenn, were tasked by Starfleet with a top secret mission to develop a new kind of faster-than-light drive utilizing spores from the fungus Prototaxites stellaviatori. Discovery was assigned to work with Lieutenant Paul Stamets who managed to have Lorca pull some strings and take on Cadet Sylvia Tilly. (DSC comic: Discovery Annual 2018)
In November of the same year, Lorca puppeted events so that the Discovery would cross paths with the prison shuttle of former officer Michael Burnham. Lorca assigned her to work with Stamets' team in developing the new spore drive, and after joining the boarding party to the disabled USS Glenn, Burnham accepted Lorca's offer of parole to work aboard the Discovery.

description_text:
This is a bladeless Military/Police drone from my tutorial series. I am inspired by the audi police drone and I modified it, to fit in to a beginner modeling tutorial. 
The drone was modelled in Maya with a clean quad topology with 3700 faces which is subdivision ready and I already attached a subdivided high poly version.All the photos had been rendered with Blender cylces.
The drone has 3 form:                                                Military with Missles.                                                Police with cameras.                                                Standard version without additional elements.
The police and Military version comes with 2 and 4k textures and the standard comes with a 2k texture.All the equipment has 2k textures.
The model can be imported to Unreal 5 and it generates an automatic rig.If for some reason it does not do it. I attached a blenderfile what is properly setted up so you can use that. 
If you have any questions or something is not working as it should, feel free to reach out to me and I am more than happy to help.

For these images, the object file was loaded into GravitySketch on an Oculus Quest and images were taken around and inside of the model.

description_text:
This is my take on Optimus Prime Generation 1 design. This character is fully rigged with a self automated transform mechanic from robot to truck form. Within the rig it has IK/FK functions for the hands and legs with switches.  If you are interested please watch the rig demo video which goes over every part of the rig. description_text: This model is based off of the Eaglemoss colectible of the Prydwen, which I purchased and then took measurements off of. I recreated the model to within a milimeter of precision, and test printed it to compare. The model doesn't come with a stand, and the vertibird gantries need to be printed 4 times, and then glued on. It's designed to be the same size and measurements as its real counterpart, which comes out to 8 inches long. I printed it on an FDM printer, but Resin would probably work better. It was designed in Fusion 360, and took about 25 hours to design.

This is Version 1 model please check my store for version 2 of this model.
[ The different between version 1 and version 2 of this model is that the version 2 have real hole at corner casting and in version 1 the poly count is low compare to version 2. So choose which version is more suitable to your project ]  
Note : Sir/Mam Before Buy this Model please check into my store, I have this model with a collection which will get huge discount. Thanks
Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2019 

  - PBR : Yes 

  - Clean UV: Yes, Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Rendered with marmoset toolbag 3 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 2706

  - Tris: 5394

  - Verts: 3310

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

  -  USDZ + glTF and .glb

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 3 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty, Rusty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W:243cm x L:606cm x H: 259cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Partial overlapping in the UV's to save space.

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in maya 2019 

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, non-overlapping

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 3 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 3281

  - Tris: 6368

  - Verts: 3796

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

  -  USDZ + glTF and .glb

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Includes 3 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty, Rusty) with Texture Dimension 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W:243cm x L:606cm x H: 259cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

description_text:
A boat is a watercraft of a large range of types and sizes, but generally smaller than a ship, which is distinguished by its larger size, shape, cargo or passenger capacity, or its ability to carry boats.
Small boats are typically found on inland waterways such as rivers and lakes, or in protected coastal areas. However, some boats, such as the whaleboat, were intended for use in an offshore environment. In modern naval terms, a boat is a vessel small enough to be carried aboard a ship. Anomalous definitions exist, as lake freighters 1,000 feet (300 m) long on the Great Lakes are called boats.
Boats vary in proportion and construction methods with their intended purpose, available materials, or local traditions. Canoes have been used since prehistoric times and remain in use throughout the world for transportation, fishing, and sport. Fishing boats vary widely in style partly to match local conditions. Pleasure craft used in recreational boating include ski boats, pontoon boats, and sailboats. House boats may be used for vacationing or long-term residence. Lighters are used to convey cargo to and from large ships unable to get close to shore. Lifeboats have rescue and safety functions.
Boats can be propelled by manpower (e.g. rowboats and paddle boats), wind (e.g. sailboats), and motor (including gasoline, diesel, and electric).

description_text: The container measures 8x 4 x 4" so whats that like a 1:20The doors and door handles are print in place. and will pivot to open and the doors latch in the frame. You can choose to print with your own supports or the supports I added that you see in green in the pictures provided. The door hinges are designed with a tiny member between them and rest of the frame so they will be supported during the print as I found that as the doors are printed they can sometimes rotate during the printing process. I have run many experiments to get this to print consistently with my two printers and included in these files is every iteration for you to be successful. You will need to add supports under the pull tabs that swing out and you will need to clip off the door supports from my file if you print that version.In the files youll find a single piece version where it all prints as one piece, a 2pc version where the door frame is printed separately from the main body, and 3 pc version that prints the door frame, mid body, and endcap. additionally theres a version of the midbody where you can have two door frames on each end.2pc and 3pc versions need to be glued together. Also there are versions with and without a flat pad to put logos or labels on.

description_text:
Note : Sir/Mam Before Buy this Model please check into my store, I have this model with a collection which will get huge discount. Thanks
Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2020 

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, non-overlapping

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry:      ModelA/ModelB/ModelC

  - Polys: 70   / 282  / 562

  - Tris: 140   / 564  / 1120

  - Verts: 72  / 284  / 608

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

  -  USDZ + glTF and .glb

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Textures map with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

description_text:
What is it?
Gravity boots are fundamentally sturdy ankle boots that allow a person to hang upside down by their feet. It is called inversion therapy, or simply inversion.
Geometry.
There are two objects - the left boot and the right one. They are simply a mirrored copy of one another and use the same UV layout. 
The models have been triangulated. Each boot contains 3.392 verts and 6.268 tris. 
Textures.
The pipeline is the standard PBR metal/roughness. The used channels are:

  - Base color (sRGB)

  - Metallic (linear)

  - Roughness (linear)

  - Normal (directX and openGL)

Pay attention that the final textures are different for Unity, Unreal Engine, and Blender.
The textures are available in the following sizes:

  - 4K

  - 2K

  - 1K

  - 512

Game ready For Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine and etc include Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design and other real-time apps. Made for use in Video Games but you can use it for basically anything.  

  - Originally created in Maya 2020 

  - PBR : Yes

  - Clean UV: Yes, non-overlapping

  - Rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4 and Marmoset Scene included in file 

|SPEC|Geometry: 

  - Polys: 383

  - Tris: 750

  - Verts: 416

|3D Model File Formats|

  -  .Ma + .Max

  -  .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc 

  -  .unitypackage + .uasset

  -  USDZ + glTF and .glb

All textures are include in zip file, textures map for PBR MetalRough, Unity(Standard), Unity HD Render Pipeline, Unreal Engine, Arnold, V-Ray, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell, Spark AR Studio and More!!!
Textures map with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.
(Sample of PBR MetalRough Basic Textures set)

  - 4096x4096 Albedo(Basecolor) 

  - 4096x4096 Metallic

  - 4096x4096 Roughness 

  - 4096x4096 Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(Both included) 

  - 4096x4096 Ambient occlusion (AO)

|General Char| 

  - Game Ready model 

  - Modeled in Maya

  - Low poly Mesh 

  - No ngons 

  - No seams

  - No Plugin needs 

  - No hidden geometry 

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0. 

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm) 

  - Approximate dimensions: W: 139cm x L: 62cm x H: 45cm 

  - Scene organized by layers 

  - Arrange properly the files and rename the layers 

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh. 

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

Note : - Product does not include high mesh

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder 

  - Texture Quality Guarantee

  - Free Ambient occlusion textures are also included 

  - Included substance painter file which you can edit your own logo/text and you also can change the texture Color or increased/decreased the Dirty level then export those textures for use in any engine.

description_text:
armoured vehicle concept high poly model, intended for a wide range of applications such as VFX, animation, or games. The model is a personal concept, meaning it can be used for futuristic or contemporary-set productions where a unique vehicle is required.My intention with this vehicle was to create an armoured vehicle that had the capacity to carry troops, be a mobile centre of operations and also have interchangeable modules: therefore the back module is designed to be replaced, either with another type of module or with a weapon such as an artillery piece, or used for transport of goods. Furthermore, the back module is designed to be able to link up with others to form a base in a desired location, where it can be dropped off by the vehicle.This model is quite high-poly, and textures for it were made in Substance Painter. The render was done in blender's cycles render engine.
If the file formats are not suitable for your application or you have issues with the model or even would like to have me modify it for your application, email me at nik.cg.art@gmail.com for a faster response, as I am unlikely to be able to immediately see your message in CGtrader. 
It hope you like it, thanks for showing an interest in my art.

description_text:
A teardrop trailer, also known as a teardrop camper trailer, is a streamlined, compact, lightweight travel trailer, which gets its name from its teardrop profile. They usually only have sleeping space for two adults and often have a basic kitchen in the rear.
 
Teardrop trailers first became popular in the 1930s, when magazines such as Mechanix Illustrated published plans. The first teardrop designs incorporated standard 4 by 8-foot sheets of plywood with hardwood spars. Teardrop trailers remained popular until the mid-1960s, after which they disappeared from mainstream camping. However, in the late 1990s, plans became available on the Internet and in recent years teardrop trailers have made a resurgence and are again growing in popularity

description_text:
Ready to render at 3dsmax with VRAY. It was rendered at 3dsmax 2016 with vray3.4
Rendering scene with all lightning, materials, background setups is included only for 3dsmax2016 vray3 format.
3dsmax 2010 format is also included, but without lightning/rendering studio setups and with standard materials only.
Other than 3dsmax files (3ds,fbx,lwo,c4d,obj) include only standard materials without advanced shadders or background setup.
All of our models was made on the 3dsmax, and we are able to provide uncollapsed modifier stack only for the 3dsmax. but if you'd need the lower polygon version at other programs, please contact with the support, and we will convert the reduced mesh to requested format. The lowest available meshsmooth level is shown at the wire view, next to the hipoly wire view.
For this product there's 3 different 3dsmax files included. Set is uncollapsed, it's a file where you can make changes at the model. Hipoly is collapsed to hipoly with all the modifiers history cleaned to make it trouble free while using at other programs Studio is the file with all rendering setups that we used to make the previews renderings.
Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.

description_text:
This was modeled in Spaceclaim Engineer and rendered in Keyshot.  The bicycle seat that it was designed around was downloaded from Grabcad.  
The idea behind this bike case is that it is made out of any rubber like material, such as what is available on Shapeways, Objet Printers, or others.  The case needs to be stiffer than the cover. The reason is that the case needs to maintain its grip on the seatpost and the seat support bars while loaded. For that reason a high durometer material should be used.  The cover needs to be more flexible so that when squeezed, the slot opens. The inspiration is a small rubber coinpurse.

Volkswagen ID. Buzz
Lowpoly model of german concept van

The Volkswagen ID. Buzz is a battery electric minivan produced by German manufacturer Volkswagen. Based on the dedicated battery electric MEB platform, it is the first production electric minivan from Volkswagen and part of the Volkswagen ID. series. The vehicle was first shown as a concept car at the 2017 North American International Auto Show. The production vehicle was unveiled in March 2022 with two models: a five-seater under the name ID. Buzz, and a cargo van as the ID. Buzz Cargo. According to product lead Jeffrey Lear, the styling of the ID. Buzz was chosen to “be modern and fresh and exciting for folks who may not have even been around 60ties” while retaining cues to the original Type 2 (T1)/Microbus, including the prominent front-mounted logo and (optional) two-tone paint.

overview:
Set of 8 different HO scale park benches designed for 1:87 model railways and dioramas.All benches are built as modular parts – separate bases and slats/backrests – so you can 3D print them without supports and in different colors (e.g. white concrete + brown wood).
These benches are generic, modern designs that fit European city parks, railway stations, plazas or residential areas.
What’s included
8 unique bench designs (with and without backrest, modern and classic shapes)
Each bench split into concrete base and wooden slats/backrest
Combined plate with all benches for batch printing
Individual STL files for every bench and every part (easy to re-use or re-arrange)
Scale & dimensions
Scale: HO 1:87
Designed to represent real benches around 1.5 m long (≈ 17 mm in 1:87)
Proportions matched to standard HO scale figures and street furniture
Printing & assembly
All parts are oriented for 3D printing – no supports required
Optimized for both FDM and resin printers
*Recommended materials:*Bases: PLA / PETG / ABS, light grey or white (concrete look)
Slats: any filament in brown/wood color
Simple assembly: glue the slats/backrest to the base after painting
You can easily scale up in your slicer for 1:72, 1:48, 1:35 etc.
Perfect for:
HO scale model railways (station platforms, parks, bus stops)
Architectural models and urban planning concepts
Dioramas and war-gaming tables
Any scene that needs small, detailed modern benches
Custom work
If you need custom miniature street furniture or similar 3D models (benches, lamps, bins, fences, etc.), feel free to contact me – I’m available for commission work based on your specific project and scale.
License & notes
Digital product only – no physical items included.
Royalty-free for personal and non-commercial use (layouts, dioramas, renders, videos, etc.).
Not allowed: mass production of physical parts for resale, or reselling/redistributing the 3D files themselves.

Stylized Festive Carnival Carriage 3D Model
Description: Infuse your project with a dose of magical elegance and holiday charm using the Stylized Festive Carnival Carriage 3D Model. This distinctive asset is ideal for fantasy RPGs, winter wonderland showcases, or digital diorama designs requiring a royal holiday aesthetic. It serves as a compelling prop-vehicle hybrid that reimagines a classic transport as a sparkling, ornate masterpiece.
The model showcases a graceful, curved chassis painted in a deep, glittering crimson red, heavily adorned with golden stars and sparkling textures. Unique to this variant is the polished gold railing and intricate filigree trimming, adding a layer of regal, antique craftsmanship feel. It features a roof-mounted deck lined with festive garlands and warm string lights that convey a welcoming atmosphere. The four large wheels are crafted from solid gold with detailed spokes, appearing pristine and ready for a grand parade. The visual style is distinctly magical keepsake or high-end holiday decoration, utilizing rich specular maps of glitter and gold leaf against a clean white background.

Sparkling Red Finish: Features advanced texturing with a glitter-fused crimson paint job that catches the light, mimicking the look of a vehicle designed for grand celebrations and magical events.
Ornate Gold Accents: The window frames, wheels, and body trim feature a bright polished gold metallic shader, distinguishing it from standard wooden carriages and giving it a unique royal procession or fantasy luxury look.
Festive Illumination: The roof and body are accentuated with glowing warm string lights and hanging lanterns, creating an immediate focal point and giving the carriage a sense of warmth and coziness.
Pristine Royal Wheels: The wheels are detailed with clean, golden surfaces and star-shaped hubs, grounding the asset in a narrative of high-status travel or magical journeys.
Versatile Application: Excellent for use as a specialized quest vehicle, a centerpiece for a town square event, or a focal point in a fantasy collector's showcase.

Asset BreakdownHere is an explanation of the design and unique characteristics of this 3D vehicle model:
The Overall Concept This asset takes the iconic, utilitarian silhouette of a classic American school bus and subverts expectations with a vibrant, monochromatic Bubblegum Pink theme. It transforms a standard industrial vehicle into a playful, stylized piece of digital art suitable for pop-culture or surreal environments.
Monochromatic Bodywork The model features a clean, high-gloss pink finish across the entire exterior. Unlike standard buses with black trim and yellow panels, this model leans into a minimalist aesthetic where the saturated pink dominates the hood, roof, and side panels.
Classic Industrial Geometry Underneath the stylized color, the geometry remains true to a heavy-duty transport vehicle. It includes accurate details like the reinforced front bumper, rounded fenders, traditional folding passenger door, and a multi-pane windshield layout.
Hardware and Contrast To maintain a sense of realism, functional elements use contrasting materials. The massive rubber tires, side-view mirrors, and heavy bumpers are rendered in a matte charcoal/black, providing a grounded visual weight to the whimsical pink body.
Lighting and Glass The model includes realistic glass shaders for the windows, reflecting the environment to add depth. Traditional safety lights (red and amber) are positioned on the upper brow of the bus, retaining the functional stop signaling hardware typical of the vehicle type.
Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures).Quick Tip: This model uses a Sub-Surface Scattering (SSS) property on the pink paint. When rendering, a slight SSS value will give the bus a soft, plastic-like or candy glow, enhancing the toy-like aesthetic under bright studio lighting.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall ConceptThis asset is a haunting landmark for any urban wasteland. It is a full-sized city transit bus that has been stripped and decayed, perfect for blocking off roads or creating cover in post-apocalyptic, war-torn, or horror-themed city levels.

  - Hollowed-Out InteriorThe bus features a fully accessible interior. The windshield and side windows are completely shattered, and the front door is missing, allowing players to walk through the aisle and use the rusted passenger seats as tactical cover.

  - Advanced Decay TexturesThe once-bright blue and white paint is now peeling away to reveal layers of deep rust and oxidized metal. Realistic grime and soot stains are baked into the textures, giving the vehicle a believable, weathered look.

  - Shredded Metal DetailsThe body panels are shredded and torn, with sharp metal edges sticking out from the roof and sides. These high-detail battle scars suggest a history of extreme heat or structural collapse, making the asset feel authentic to a disaster zone.

  - Peeling AdvertisementsAdding a touch of sad realism, the remains of colorful advertising posters are still stuck to the side of the bus. The paper is torn and faded, acting as a small piece of environmental storytelling about the world before the collapse.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures).Quick Tip: The Glass Shards and Loose Wires inside the cabin are low-poly planes with alpha-mask textures. This provides high visual complexity without sacrificing performance in real-time game engines.

description_text:
Exhaust manifold made in CATIA V5 and rendered in Keyshot 10.
In automotive engineering, an exhaust manifold collects the exhaust gases from multiple cylinders into one pipe. The word manifold comes from the Old English word manigfeald (from the Anglo-Saxon manig [many] and feald [fold]) and refers to the folding together of multiple inputs and outputs (in contrast, an inlet or intake manifold supplies air to the cylinders).
Exhaust manifolds are generally simple cast iron or stainless steel units which collect engine exhaust gas from multiple cylinders and deliver it to the exhaust pipe. For many engines, there are aftermarket tubular exhaust manifolds known as headers in American English, as extractor manifolds in British and Australian English,[1] and simply as tubular manifolds in British English.[citation needed] These consist of individual exhaust headpipes for each cylinder, which then usually converge into one tube called a collector. Headers that do not have collectors are called zoomie headers.
The most common types of aftermarket headers are made of mild steel or stainless steel tubing for the primary tubes along with flat flanges and possibly a larger diameter collector made of a similar material as the primaries. They may be coated with a ceramic-type finish (sometimes both inside and outside), or painted with a heat-resistant finish, or bare. Chrome plated headers are available but these tend to blue after use. Polished stainless steel will also color (usually a yellow tint), but less than chrome in most cases.
Another form of modification used is to insulate a standard or aftermarket manifold. This decreases the amount of heat given off into the engine bay, therefore reducing the intake manifold temperature. There are a few types of thermal insulation but three are particularly common:
Ceramic paint is sprayed or brushed onto the manifold and then cured in an oven. These are usually thin, so have little insulatory properties; however, they reduce engine bay heating by lessening the heat output via radiation.A ceramic mixture is bonded to the manifold via thermal spraying to give a tough ceramic coating with very good thermal insulation. This is often used on performance production cars and track-only racers.Exhaust wrap is wrapped completely around the manifold. Although this is cheap and fairly simple, it can lead to premature degradation of the manifold.The goal of performance exhaust headers is mainly to decrease flow resistance (back pressure), and to increase the volumetric efficiency of an engine, resulting in a gain in power output. The processes occurring can be explained by the gas laws, specifically the ideal gas law and the combined gas law.

Realistic Worn Two Post Car Lift 3D Model
This highly detailed 3D model of a worn, rusty two-post car lift brings industrial realism to your scenes, perfect for classic garages, vintage autoshops, and gritty workshop environments.

  - Realistic Design: Every scratch, rust patch, and weathered detail has been meticulously crafted for an authentic aged appearance.

  - High-Quality PBR Textures: Includes 4K high-resolution diffuse, roughness, normal, and metallic maps to achieve a true-to-life rusty metal effect

  - Optimized Topology: Clean, efficient topology that balances visual fidelity and performance.

  - Realistic Scale: Modeled to real-world dimensions, making it easy to integrate seamlessly into your projects.

  - Game and Real-Time Ready: Optimized for use in real-time applications, ideal for gaming or real-time rendering needs.

  - Ready-to-Use: Textures and materials are pre-mapped and configured for seamless integration in all provided formats, except for OBJ, which includes only the UV layout.

Perfect for:

  - Realistic Scenes: Add authenticity to garage, workshop, and industrial settings.

  - Game Development: Excellent for games that need detailed environmental props.

  - Archviz Projects: Ideal for adding an extra layer of realism to architectural visualizations.

Whether for a classic autoshop or a gritty mechanic’s workshop, this worn Two Post Car Lift will enhance the atmosphere of any project with an extra level of detail and realism.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall Concept This vehicle is a manifestation of raw speed and elemental power. It reimagines a high-performance racing motorcycle as if it were forged directly from a thunderhead, making it the ultimate ride for a storm god or a sci-fi racer in a surrealist tournament.

  - Condensed Cloud Chassis The fairings and bodywork are not made of carbon fiber or metal; they are composed of dense, dark grey storm clouds. The texture appears volumetric and swirling, giving the bike a shifting, gaseous solidity that looks like a contained tornado.

  - Voltaic Energy Veins Cracking across the cloudy surface are jagged streaks of bright blue and violet lightning. These arcing bolts act as the decals of the bike, constantly shifting and pulsing to suggest that a massive electrical charge is powering the engine.

  - Plasma-Halo Rims The wheels eschew traditional spokes for glowing rings of neon energy. The tires themselves seem infused with the same storm magic, glowing with intense cyan and purple light that would leave a trail of scorched ozone on the asphalt.

  - Aerodynamic Sport Profile Despite its chaotic elemental texture, the bike retains the sleek silhouette of a modern superbike. It features a sharp front nose, a clear windshield, and an aggressive rider stance, ensuring it remains recognizable as a functional vehicle.

Technical Notes:Files Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures). Quick Tip: To sell the cloud effect without heavy simulation, use a Flow Map on the dark grey texture to make the clouds slowly swirl. The lightning needs a high-intensity Emission Map with a flickering animation curve.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall Concept This vehicle is a ferocious blend of dark fantasy sorcery and heavy machinery. It reimagines a chopper motorcycle as an animated stone construct, shaped like a giant wolf, making it the perfect mount for a barbarian warlord or a lunar cultist.

  - Sculpted Granite Chassis The main body is not metal, but jagged, dark grey stone carved into the likeness of a snarling wolf. The texture resembles rough-hewn granite or obsidian, giving the bike a heavy, indestructible appearance that looks like a moving statue.

  - Runic Enchantments Glowing cyan runes are etched deeply into the stone body and the tires. These magical sigils pulse with light, suggesting that the vehicle is powered by ancient spells or necromancy rather than gasoline.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall Concept This asset is a custom Cafe Racer motorcycle, a style famous in the 1960s for being stripped down and modified for speed. It looks heavily used, rusted, and garage-built, making it perfect for a post-apocalyptic game or a gritty mechanic's workshop.

  - Raw Metal Fuel Tank The gas tank has no paint; it is just bare steel covered in patches of rust and scratches. This rat bike look suggests the owner cares more about speed and mechanics than shiny decoration.

  - Wrapped Exhaust Pipes The hot exhaust pipes are wrapped in strips of tan fabric (heat tape). Custom bike builders use this to keep heat inside the pipes, but visually, it adds a fantastic rough texture that contrasts with the hard metal engine.

  - Worn Brown Leather Seat The seat is a simple, flat cushion covered in brown leather. It looks aged, cracked, and weather-beaten, matching the overall neglected but functional vibe of the machine.

  - Stripped-Down Frame There are no plastic covers or fairings on this bike. The frame is open, exposing the engine, the battery box, and the air filters, giving the model a complex, mechanical silhouette.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures). Quick Tip: The Exhaust Wrap texture is very detailed. To make it look like real fabric, apply a strong Normal Map so the light catches the weave of the cloth tape, distinguishing it from the smooth metal parts.

description_text:
A set of high-quality sci-fi themed assets with a focus on zero gravity environments with ultimate visual quality and great, customizable materials.
The first installment of the Zero Gravity asset series. Designed for high-end desktops, the package provides you with the tools to build stunning sci-fi themed environments, and with the combination of Unreal's powerful material system, tune the mood of your environment from brand new, to old and abandoned. 
The package features static meshes with face weighted normals, tiling base materials, and detail decals to ensure the best possible visual quality even at very close distances. Base materials feature multiple parameters such as; Base Roughness, Roughness variation, Material color, color variation, Material variation ( create cracked or chipped paint etc), texture and variation sizes etc. All source materials for static meshes and textures available on request. 
Package features · High-quality static meshes with face weighted normals · Highly customizable base materials · Decal textures for details · Fully PBR textures sourced from scanned data · Variation masks used for roughness and material variationTechnical Details

description_text:
This is a pack of 6 Futuristic Vehicles I created with main purpose of being used in video games.
It Contains: 2 Muscle Cars /2 Exotic Cars /2 Flying Vehicles /TEXTURES:2048x2048 for Body /1024x1024 for Tires /512*512 for Wheels
!Underside of these cars are mostly untextured!
Each Car texture ZIP contains individual Material textures for PBR, Unity URP, Unreal 4 (Packed). (Textures for Unreal are not tested!)
With following colors : White, Black, Red
  - To get other colors for cars use red color texture and edit (Hue/Saturation/Brightness) for red channel. 
I also included texture maps for multiple surface types - Metallic/Non Metallic maps & Matte/SemiGloss/Gloss Roughness maps. 
With these textures you should easily be able to get many color variations. (I tried it on Blender using nodes, and For unity I edited them with Photoshop and just imported texture.)
Each cars also contains individual set of wheels with textures and a set of tires with textures. (It should be simple to swap them if you want to change the look even more.)
One Car (Black Muscle Car) has Additional Addons I only did for fun. They include Exhausts, Drivetrain, Engine all with textures.
Okay. Now the lucky Tris Numbers!Im showing Combined numbers including Wheels,Tires,Addons. 
BMC : 13,207
BRT : 7,806
SMC : 12,014
SRC : 9,182
FTV : 1,906  ...An actual low polly model! :O 
FAV : 3,464
PS.If you want to test out some of these models without purchasing them you will be able to! As Ill be releasing a free test pack containing 3 of these models in the next day after I publish this pack,and you will be able to find them in my profile. :)This is my first asset pack im publishing and as I am learning Im open for any feedback!

description_text:
A model of a small-to-medium sized exploration spaceship: the Interceptor I.
The spaceship is a hierarchy of 90 objects all well-organized and cleanly named (for meshes, textures, shaders).Meshes are UV unwrapped (overlapping UVs) and textured with PBR materials.The file only contains a dark metal / orange light materials combo but these materials can be easily adapted to get the other colors as shown in the previews.
The interior of the spaceship is simply a black inner hull to hide the exterior panels, and a basic door to separate the cockpit from the rest of the spacecraft.The stars skydome is not included in the file.
Modeled in Blender (2.93) for the EEVEE engine, available in the following formats: DAE, ABC, FBX, OBJ.Ready for games (low-poly: < 20k faces).

description_text:
A model of a large-sized cargo spaceship: the Scavenger I.
The spaceship is a hierarchy of 43 objects all well-organized and cleanly named (for meshes, textures, shaders). Meshes are UV unwrapped (overlapping UVs) and textured with PBR materials. The file only contains a dark metal / orange light materials combo but these materials can be easily adapted to get the other colors as shown in the previews.
The stars skydome is not included in the file.
Modeled in Blender (2.93) for the EEVEE engine, available in the following formats: DAE, ABC, FBX, OBJ. Ready for games (low-poly: < 20k faces).

This is the pack that accompanied our Youtube complete guide.

description_text:
This is a DIY Kit for turning your RC car into a offroad juggernaught. Meant for 4wd vehicles using a 12 mm drive hex. It was designed to be a direct bolt on for the 4wd Traxxas Stampede but will fit many other vehicles with a 12mm drive hub. The drive hubs could be altered to fit whatever vehicle you are running. You could also bolt two on the rear of a 2WD and really have something interesting.. the possibilities are endless. (Note) (There isn't a part i because capital i's look like 1's and didn't want confusion)  We added a Bumpstop plate that should be printed in TPU or a soft material that will prevent the tracks from doing a full rotation ,it will still allow the individual tracks at each end 'float' and semi rotate with the terrain but will stop it from doing a full rotation. All files have been updated. 
(Materials) All parts is recommended to be printed in ABS or stronger material the Track pieces themselves were designed to be printed in TPU we tested with a Hardness rating of 95A feel free to experiment however you see fit. 
(PARTS NEEDED: NOT INCLUDED)  (4qty - 20x32x7 mm Bearings , 16 qty- 5x11x4 mm bearings, 8qty - 2.5 x 10mm steel pins, 4 qty 3637 Traxxas axle packs 8 individual axles in all, 52qty M4x20 mm machine screws, 20qty M4 locknuts, 200 qty 2mm x 50 mm steel rod for tracks, ) UxCell has a very good price in hardware and bearings, Order the Traxxas axles from traxxas and not Amazon because they will combine shipping.  Also addition of M2 machine screws or self tapping as some of the lower holes have been resized for strength and weight purposes. Steel Pins (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07232VWLT/ref=ox_sc_act_title_4?smid=A2PMIWMSUTAYGS&psc=1 )
Instructions included in the pictures.

description_text:
CHIBI-TECH SD modular Mecha.  30mm chibi (super-deform) sci-fi tabletop miniatures series come with a single-piece .STL and FDM-optimized versions for quality supportless printing. Many include free alternate variant sculpts. Also includes ready-to-print .PNG format GAME CARD(S). Designed to be 100% modular by using 6x1.5mm neodynium magnets.   
BUG-HUNT is a CHIBI SCI-FI SPACE-CRAWL SURVIVAL HORROR game within the CHIBI-TECH SD UNIVERSE. Designed for use with 30mm Chibi Minis, Grow Your Character and Your Squad as You take on Missions and fight for survival as You delve deeper within Space Wreckage Ships, Enemy Fortifications, Alien Hives and anything in bewteen using a Procedurally Generated Map based on Mission-Based Terrain Decks and Encounters.   Hack Consoles, Jury-rig Hatches, Search for Gear and Valuable Survival Items all while exploring unknown Corridors that are different EVERY Time. Use Your Skills, Complete the Mission, and Survive to Earn GTC to better Your Crew, Gear, Training Engrams, and Dropship!
V-03 BATTLE BUGGY:  Used originally by The SPACE-FORCE expeditionary teams as a light recon rover, this agile little vehicle proved its worth in battle as a fast moving, hard to hit target that can take a beating for it's slight mass.  A Roller Vehicle in design, it hosts a single hardpoint limited to weight class 1 modules includeing SMT's, Dorsal Guns, ML pods, Hatch Gunners, and a multitude of Device choices dependant on the situation or mission.   It's lightweight design and large all-terrain tires grant it Agility and a high Dash from it's efficient engine. Never under-estimate fast hit and run tactics, and it excels in packs.   Speaking of which, This File Pack includes TWO variants of the Battle Buggy ready for resin or supportless FDM printing as well as an in-game CHIBI-TECH SD STAT CARD in .PNG format.

Thick Angular Armor provides extra protection against Kinetic Weaponry and designed for incursions into Enemy terrain as well as frequently used by The CORP in Urban scenarios involving riots and protestors, it is designed to shrug off man-poratble Small-Arms fire.  Internally it's spacious enough for an entire Squad of Infantry (5 Troops) which can Deploy as the APC's Action, leaving the Troops to act Immediately upon Activation.   Designed by Toshiba Corp, these units are widely used in a multitude of situations across many worlds, but The CORP has bid for  a large production contract and so it has become a standard use Vehicle for the GDC Forces.   It can be substituted for a Dropship or used in concert with one in CHIBI-TECH SD as well as BUG-HUNT for land-based Missions. description_text:
The Zorro LARHC (light attack/reconnaissance hovercraft) produced by Shiaic Inc, is an ideal rapid-strike platform well-suited to the role of massed formation lightning swarm tactics or solo-vehicle recon tasks.
Its low technology base of design and inexpensive manufacturing production cost makes the Zorro an ideal fleet vehicle. It is an especially attractive option for any fiscally-constrained Periphery planetary garrison force, shoestring-budget militia (or insurgent/revolutionaries), or hard-luck mercenary outfit.
The vehicle's simple means of operation incorporates an integrated fire control system intuitively combined with its easy-to-use steerage controls. This allows for the rapid training of crew and new reinforcements (or mass-conscription draftees), and thus the operators of a fleet of Zorros can often throw them into the heat of action very soon after taking delivery of the assets.
Additionally, the Zorro is just the lightest platform in a wider family of highly interchangeable vehicles based on the same chassis design. This often allows for Zorro fleet owners to run a fully compatible logistics and repair operation with enhanced efficiency.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall Concept This is the quintessential prop for any modern city environment. It represents the standard, heavy-duty waste bin found in public parks, bus stops, and city sidewalks, adding a necessary layer of lived-in realism to urban scenes.

  - Black Steel Slat Cage The outer shell is constructed from vertical black metal slats welded to circular rims. The paint finish is satin but shows signs of weathering, with subtle scuffs and fading that suggest years of exposure to the elements.

  - Galvanized Inner Liner Resting inside the black cage is a beat-up, galvanized steel bucket. This inner bin features realistic imperfections, including dents, oxidation stains, and a dull metallic sheen that contrasts with the darker exterior.

  - Plastic Bag Detail To enhance the realism, a black plastic trash bag is draped over the rim of the inner bucket. The bag features intricate folds and wrinkles with a higher specular value (shininess) than the metal, catching the light like varied plastic polymers.

  - Accumulated Grime The base of the receptacle features accumulated dirt and rust around the bottom rim. This grounding detail helps blend the object into the sidewalk texture, ensuring it doesn't look like it's floating above the pavement.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures). Quick Tip: Material separation is key here. The Plastic Bag needs low Roughness to look wet/shiny, while the Black Slats should be rougher. Use a Normal Map to exaggerate the dents on the silver liner without adding geometry.

Asset BreakdownThe Overall ConceptThis asset is a high-fidelity, 3D-modeled realistic heavy armored motorcycle 3D model designed as a primary tactical vehicle for futuristic combat zones, cinematic sci-fi sequences, or advanced military visualizations. Focusing on a ballistic-interceptor aesthetic, this model features a reinforced streetfighter silhouette integrated with interlocking hexagonal armor plating, making it an ideal choice for high-end character renders, covert-insertion quest objectives, or as a flagship player vehicle in realistic 3D games.
Brushed Steel and Hexagonal Composite FinishThe motorcycle features a primary body finish of weathered brushed steel and matte charcoal hexagonal plates, meticulously modeled with authentic surface panel bolts, subtle metallic edge wear, and prominent industrial-fortification highlights. This professional and aggressive appearance provides a clear visual story of a frontline combat machine, providing a sharp visual contrast against the dark-tinted ballistic headlight housing and the heavy-duty matte-black tires.
High-Fidelity Interlocking Armor and Chassis GeometryA primary feature of this model is the integrated hexagonal reactive armor suite and reinforced structural frame. Every individual bolt head on the armor panels, the detailed honeycomb texture of the main fairing, and the realistic mechanical layering of the front fork shields and under-cowl plating are modeled with significant surface depth, providing a clear visual indicator of advanced defensive engineering and adding incredible tactile detail for close-up inspection.
Heavy-Duty Suspension and Tactical ConfigurationThe bike is characterized by its high-detail military configuration featuring thick-gauge telescopic forks and a robust rear mono-shock assembly. The structural design—complete with various technical components like dual front disc brakes with heavy-duty calipers, oversized all-terrain knobby tires on reinforced black alloy wheels, and a low-slung performance exhaust—reinforces the asset's status as a functional and complete piece of professional-grade, high-performance tactical hardware.
Optimized High-Fidelity GeometryThe entire realistic heavy armored motorcycle 3D model is composed of efficient geometry designed for high-performance real-time rendering. Every element, from the individual radiator fins and handlebar grips to the solid armored shell and heavy-duty engine casing, is modeled as solid, opaque geometry to maintain a consistent realistic look without the need for complex, resource-heavy transparency shaders.
Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures).
Quick Tip: To enhance the realism in a sun-drenched industrial district or a dark moody rainy night-patrol, apply a high-detail Ambient Occlusion Map specifically to the recessed hexagonal panel lines and the bolt clusters. This will create realistic contact shadows and depth-look lighting that contrast beautifully with the brushed metal surfaces under dynamic lighting, showcasing the asset's diverse material quality and premium industrial design.

description_text:
CHIBI-TECH SD modular Mecha.  30mm chibi (super-deform) sci-fi tabletop miniatures series come with a single-piece .STL and FDM-optimized versions for quality supportless printing. Many include free alternate variant sculpts. Also includes ready-to-print .PNG format GAME CARD(S). Designed to be 100% modular by using 6x1.5mm neodynium magnets.   
BUG-HUNT is a CHIBI SCI-FI SPACE-CRAWL SURVIVAL HORROR game within the CHIBI-TECH SD UNIVERSE. Designed for use with 30mm Chibi Minis, Grow Your Character and Your Squad as You take on Missions and fight for survival as You delve deeper within Space Wreckage Ships, Enemy Fortifications, Alien Hives and anything in bewteen using a Procedurally Generated Map based on Mission-Based Terrain Decks and Encounters.   Hack Consoles, Jury-rig Hatches, Search for Gear and Valuable Survival Items all while exploring unknown Corridors that are different EVERY Time. Use Your Skills, Complete the Mission, and Survive to Earn GTC to better Your Crew, Gear, Training Engrams, and Dropship!
V-02 BLACK MAMMOTH MOBILE TACTICAL COMMAND UNIT:  The backbone of CORPORATION Strike Missions, this Beast of a vehicle is Heavily Armored with thick Angular Plate to mitigate Kinetic weapons fire as well as being near impervious to Small-Arms Weapons.  Spacious enough to host 2 Full Squads of Infantry and Deploy them as an Action.   It's top-mount Waist-socket can support up to 5 Mass Total, allowing for nearly unlimited options of Heavy Fire Support or Pure Tactical Support Modules including Turrets, Ml systems, Cores, Heavy Devices and More.   As a Mobile tactical Command Unit it lends to inter-squad communications and oversight, granting a bonus to any Ally forces taking part in Focus Fire tactics ( Standard Training for Corporation Troop Endoctrinization). Produced by Toshiba Corp under exclusive contract to the GDC, these Vehicles are rarely seen outside of Corporation control except where salavaged or liberated by Freedom Fightewrs on the outskirts of Corporation control.   This Vehicle can be used in CHIBI-TECH SD or BUG-HUNT in place of a Dropship or in concert with a Dropship with enough cargo capacity.   This File Pack contains 1 Vehicle Modle for the BLACK MAMMOTH MTC Unit in original single-piece .STL format for Resin or Supportless FDM printing, as well as an in-game CHIBI-TECH SD STAT CARD.

description_text:
Halftrack Recovery Vehicle is a collection of 3D printable files that can be built into a variety of half-track science fiction trucks. They have been designed to print easily and to work with a variety of 28-32mm scale figures. They can be used for scatter terrain on a sci-fi tabletop for a variety of systems like Games Workshop Warhammer 40K and Warhammer 40k Kill Team, Corvus Bellis Infinity, and many other sci-fi and post-apocalyptic games.
Components
Included in Halftrack Recovery Vehicle are a variety of core components and variant pieces:

  - Truck Cabin: in two variants, and with three different backs that can be applied.

  - Chassis: in high and low versions.

  - Axle set: including left and right steering variants.

  - Wheels and Tracks for both chassis options.

  - Recovery Crane: An optional recovery crane that can be built in stowed, or deployed options.

  - Truck Tray: with a set of optional storage boxes that include a variety of doors and drawers.

This pack also works with our Outpost Utility Truck pack, to add even more variety to your sci-fi tabletop.
Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.1 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - The largest part is 90mm long, so this kit can be printed on a 100mm or larger build plate.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3.

The stark, dramatic lighting of the setting sun, with its fiery oranges and deep purples, perfectly complements the rugged aesthetic of the bike.Image 1 captures a dynamic rear three-quarter view, highlighting the aggressive knobby tires, robust suspension, and the intricate details of the exhaust system. The glowing red taillight adds a vibrant contrast to the subdued tones of the motorcycle's matte black body. The practical, distressed brown leather saddlebags are a standout feature, hinting at long journeys and enduring resilience.Image 2 offers a powerful head-on perspective, showcasing the distinctive circular LED headlight, which glows brightly, asserting the bike's modern design and readiness for any condition. The tall windscreen and wide handlebars, equipped with handguards, reinforce its off-road capability and rider protection. The symmetry and commanding presence from this angle are striking.Image 3 provides a clean side profile, revealing the full length of the motorcycle and its purposeful design. The high ground clearance, sturdy frame, and exposed engine components speak to its engineering for challenging terrains. The subtle texture of the brown seat matches the saddlebags, tying the design together seamlessly.Finally, Image 4 delivers an engaging low-angle front three-quarter view, bringing the viewer closer to the action. This perspective emphasizes the detailed front disc brakes, spoked wheels, and the sturdy engine guard, all crucial elements for an adventure bike. The entire collection exudes a sense of exploration, freedom, and the thrill of the open road, or rather, the open wilderness, under a magnificent sky.

description_text:
Outpost Utility Truck is a collection of 3D printable files that can be built into a variety of six-wheeled science fiction trucks. They have been designed to print easily and to work with a variety of 28-32mm scale figures. They can be used for scatter terrain on a sci-fi tabletop for a variety of systems like Games Workshop Warhammer 40K and Warhammer 40k Kill Team, Corvus Bellis Infinity, and many other sci-fi and post-apocalyptic games.
Components
Included in Outpost Utility Truck are a variety of core components and variant pieces:

  - Truck Cabin: in two variants, and with three different backs that can be applied.

  - Chassis: in long and short versions.

  - Axle set: including left and right steering variants.

  - Wheels: with three different types of wheel design, and a plain rubber tire for cargo.

  - Truck Tray: with four variants and a working tailgate.

  - Extras: four extra pieces that can add additional variety to the finished vehicles.

Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.1 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - The largest part is 90mm long, so this kit can be printed on a 100mm or larger build plate.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3.

description_text:
Extra Truck Bodies is a collection of 3D printable files that includes four new bodies that can be added to our truck kits for more variety. They have been designed to print easily and to work with 28-32mm scale figures. 
This is an EXPANSION KIT, and will require owning one of our other kits like the Military Truck, Prospector Rover, or Outpost Utility to use. The extra truck bodies are shown on the Military Truck kit.
Included in the kit are a Signal Body with Radar and Hex Dish, a Troop Body with bench seats, a Buffalo Tanker Body, and a flat Gun Deck Body. The Signal Body and Gun Deck can also be used stand-alone.
Printing
The pieces are designed to be printed on a home FDM 3D printer with:

  - A 0.4mm nozzle.

  - 0.08 - 0.12 mm layer height.

  - 15 - 20% infill.

  - Supports are only required for a few of the .STL files.

  - Rafts may be required for the smaller parts, depending on your 3D printer.

  - The largest part is 80mm long, so this kit can be printed on a 100mm or larger build plate.

All .STL files are oriented correctly so you can load them into your slicer and print them immediately. The parts have been designed to print face-up for the best detail. All .STL files were sliced using Cura and test printed on a Creality Ender 3.

description_text:
Overview
A detailed model, replicating a late Penny Farthing bycycle; interestingly featuring pneumatic tyres and sprung seat. 
Features

  - 90k poly detail

  - Textures include Colour, Gloss, Reflection and Normal maps for PBR workflow.

  - Highly accurate

History
The penny-farthing, also known as a high wheel, high wheeler and ordinary, was the first machine to be called a bicycle. It was popular in the 1870s and 1880s, with its large front wheel providing high speeds (owing to it travelling a large distance for every rotation of the legs) and comfort (the large wheel provides greater shock absorption). It became obsolete from the late 1880s with the development of modern bicycles, which provided similar speed amplification via chain-driven gear trains and comfort through pneumatic tyres, and were marketed in comparison to penny-farthings as safety bicycles due to the reduced danger of falling and the reduced height to fall from.

description_text:
A 3D model of a black/Grey and yellow road bollard. A sturdy, short, vertical post protruding the ground. Usually these posts are installed to control road traffic and posts designed to prevent automotive vehicles from colliding or crashing into pedestrians and structures.
Permanent bollards can be used for traffic-control or guarding against vehicle-ramming attacks. They may be mounted near enough to each other that they block ordinary cars/trucks for instance - We have demonstrated this in some of the render images above. They can also be spaced widely enough to permit special-purpose vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians to pass through. Bollards may also be used to enclose car-free zones. Bollards and other street furniture can also be used to control overspill parking onto sidewalks and verges.
The model is great to use in your games, films as CGI, VR, or animations.
It's low poly but holds enough detail to place into a scene for a realistic CGI element.
Technical Specifications: File Formats: MB, MA, OBJ, FBX, STL, VRSCENE
Other than Autodesk Maya, file types (OBJ, FBX, STL, VRSCENE) include only standard materials without advanced shaders or materials.
Whether you're a student, educator, or designer aiming for simplicity in your projects, this Road Traffic Bollard model serves as an accessible and valuable resource.
For any enquiries or customisation requests, feel free to get in touch. Your satisfaction is important to us.
ENJOY!

3D model descriptionThis 3D model replicates a modern bike helmet, designed for cycling enthusiasts and prop makers. Featuring ventilation channels, aerodynamic contours, and a lightweight shell, this helmet balances safety-inspired aesthetics with print-friendly design.
Key Features:
Aerodynamic Design: Smooth shell with integrated ventilation to mimic airflow patterns of real cycling helmets.
Ventilation Channels: Multiple air vents for realism and style.
Lightweight Structure: Hollow interior for reducing material use while maintaining a realistic look.
Modular Parts: Optional detachable visor and straps for easier 3D printing and customization.
Customizable: Print in multiple colors or add decals for personal style.
Use Cases: Cosplay, bike display props, educational models, or miniature dioramas.
3D printing settingsPrint Technology: FDM (PLA/PETG) or Resin for smoother finish
Material: PLA (easy and lightweight), PETG or ABS (stronger, more durable)
Layer Height: 0.15–0.2 mm standard, 0.1 mm for finer vent details
Infill: 20–30% for shell, higher (40%) for visor/strap reinforcements
Supports: Required under vents, visor, and strap connectors
Print Speed: 50–60 mm/s
Bed Temperature: 60 °C (PLA), 70–75 °C (PETG)
Nozzle Temperature: 200–210 °C (PLA), 230–240 °C (PETG)
Nozzle Size: 0.4 mm standard; 0.3 mm for detailed venting

description_text:
The rotating carousel brings every funfair and folk festival to life. Instead of the vehicles included, separately available figures or animal models can of course be used.
In this package are included:

  - Building instructions as PDF

  - Baseplate

  - Turnplate

  - Pillar (print 5x)

  - Roof

  - Vehicle Bus

  - Vehicle Firetruck

  - Vehicle Helicopter

  - Vehicle Ship

General information
Ideally, print all parts on an resin printer. Place the parts with the non-visible sides (inside) on the bed of the printer. This will achieve the highest quality. The components in this package have been successfully tested on a Prusa i3 MK3s (FDM) and an Anycubic Photon Mono 4K (Resin). The ideal settings of your 3D prints are up to you. We cannot make any generally valid recommendations.
Clean the components after printing and free them from print support and any material residue. If desired, it is also advisable to finish and smooth the visible surfaces afterwards with putty and sandpaper. Please keep in mind that parts often do not come out of the 3D printer perfectly accurate to size. This can lead to the fact that the components do not immediately fit together exactly, but must be processed somewhat.
Use a non-evaporating super glue for assembling the parts. This prevents vapors from condensing on transparent components, for example, and soiling them.
It is recommended to apply a primer to the components before painting. Acrylic-based paints are suitable for painting. The manufacturers Citadel & Vallejo are recommended. Clean colored surfaces can be created with an airbrush system or spray cans.

description_text: For Games and AnimationsOptimization: Ensure your models are optimized for performance. Keep the polygon count low while maintaining the essential details that make the train recognizable.Stylized Design: Embrace the low poly aesthetic by using stylized designs. Simplify shapes and exaggerate key features for a unique look.Textures and Materials: Use flat colors or simple textures to enhance the low poly style. Avoid high-resolution textures that can clash with the aesthetic.Rigging and Animation: If the train will be animated, ensure the model is properly rigged. Keep the rig simple to match the low poly style.Consistency: Maintain a consistent style throughout the project. This includes colors, shapes, and the overall design approach.For 3D PrintingStructural Integrity: Ensure your model has no thin or fragile parts that might break during printing or handling.Printable Details: Simplify details to ensure they print well. Tiny details may not come out as intended.Support Structures: Design with support structures in mind to avoid overhangs that can’t be printed without additional supports.Scale: Consider the final size of the printed model. Ensure that small parts are scaled up to be printable.Material ColorsBold and Simple Colors: Use bold, solid colors that complement each other. This can enhance the visual appeal of the low poly style.Material Choice: For games and animations, you can experiment with different shaders to create unique looks. For 3D printing, choose filament colors that match your design vision.General TipsReference Real Trains: Look at images of real trains for inspiration. Focus on capturing the essence of their design in a simplified form.Iterate: Start with a rough model and iterate, refining the design and details as you go.Feedback: Get feedback from others to improve your design. Sometimes fresh eyes can spot areas for improvement.

A clean, optimized, and modern low-poly city bus, perfect for mobile games, hyper-casual projects, or background animations.This package is designed with flexibility in mind.   - Triangles: 1,920

AVAILABLE FORMATS:

  - .fbx (Universal Exchange Format)
